name: Sailing watch system for clubs and teams

mentions.name: Sailing watch system for clubs and teams
mentions.description: A low-power sailing watch system for racing clubs and teams, built initially on the Waveshare ESP-32 watch and engineered for super low power so the battery lasts multi-day regattas that run for hours over two days, with no internet dependency since regattas are often rural. Custom hardware (probably Nordic based) is planned for the future.
mentions.problem: Existing sailing watch systems cost thousands of dollars per boat, which clubs and teams without resources cannot afford, while regattas run for hours over two days and often take place in rural areas with no internet.
mentions.audience: Sailing clubs and teams without the resources for existing systems, including competitive sailors with very high expectations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a sailing watch system for clubs and teams without the resources for existing systems (thousands of dollars per boat).

I’m starting with the Waveshare ESP-32 watch. It has a great price tag and features, and an impossibly small battery for regattas that run for hours over two days.
mentions.author: mlhpdx
